reviews.title: Great workout tool
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Hevy to track all of my strength workouts, and it has become an extremely useful part of my training routine. I have several recurring workouts—Push, Pull, Legs, and Upper—and Hevy makes it very easy to record every exercise, weight, set, and rep while I’m at the gym. I especially like being able to look back and see exactly what I did during previous workouts.

What has made it even more useful is combining Hevy with ChatGPT. After each workout, I copy my completed Hevy workout into ChatGPT, which compares it with my previous sessions and helps me decide where to increase weight or reps and where I should stay at the same level. Before my next workout, ChatGPT uses those results to give me specific targets for each exercise. It has essentially turned my Hevy workout history into an ongoing, personalized training program.

The combination has been fantastic for progressive overload because I’m no longer relying on memory or guessing what I should do next. I can see small improvements from workout to workout while also being reminded not to push an exercise too quickly when form, balance, or an old injury is a consideration. Hevy provides an excellent, simple record of what I actually accomplished, and paired with ChatGPT, it has made my workouts much more organized, measurable, and purposeful.

reviews.text: I was working with a fitness coach and made some good progress getting more fit and stronger. I decided I was in a good spot to try to maintain on my own. I needed an app or something that would help me plan and organize workouts. I downloaded a few apps to test them out. I tried Hevy and stopped right there. It has a great selection of workouts, I like the way the workouts were described and previewed, I like the easy to use interface…. It is working super well for my needs that I don’t care to try another app. Thanks Hevy!
